title: policy/mcp.lock.json
description: The tool-description lock (spec §10.1): for each pinned server, the pin it was recorded for, the raw surface it served (tools/list, instructions, prompts, resources) and that surface's hash. `hapi mcp pin` writes an entry; `hapi mcp verify` compares the live surface with it. src/mcp/lock.ts also checks that every hash matches its surface and that every tool has a name.

hash.description: hashToolSurface(surface): sha256 of the surface's canonical JSON.

pin.description: The catalog's pin fields at the time of pinning. An entry counts only while they still equal the server's.

surface.description: What the server served, as it served it. The items are upstream data, kept raw, so the schema leaves them open: tools are checked in code for a string name, and the hash covers everything.
